description: This file contains template implementations of checked arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, etc.) with overflow and validity checks, as well as classes managing numeric state for both integer and floating-point types, used for safe numeric computations.

classes.name: CheckedNumericState
classes.description: Template class managing the validity and value of numeric types, specialized for integer and floating-point types to ensure safe conversions and operations.

methods.name: CheckedAddImpl
methods.description: Performs checked addition for integral types, returning success status.

methods.name: CheckedSubImpl
methods.description: Performs checked subtraction for integral types, returning success status.

methods.name: CheckedMulImpl
methods.description: Performs checked multiplication for integral types, returning success status.

methods.name: CheckedDivOp::Do
methods.description: Performs checked division with overflow and invalid operation checks.

methods.name: CheckedMaxOp::Do
methods.description: Performs checked maximum of two values.

methods.name: CheckedMinOp::Do
methods.description: Performs checked minimum of two values.
